Advanced ATC

Pembalikan Saran Resolusi TCAS

An updated TCAS alert that instructs the flight crew to reverse a previously issued vertical avoidance maneuver due to a change in conflicting traffic behavior (ICAO Doc 9863, FAA AIM).

Quick answer: An updated TCAS alert that instructs the flight crew to reverse a previously issued vertical avoidance maneuver due to a change in conflicting traffic behavior (ICAO Doc 9863, FAA AIM).

Definition

An updated TCAS alert that instructs the flight crew to reverse a previously issued vertical avoidance maneuver due to a change in conflicting traffic behavior (ICAO Doc 9863, FAA AIM).

Operational example

If a Traffic Alert and Collision Avoidance System Resolution Advisory Reversal is issued, immediately reverse your vertical maneuver as instructed by TCAS.

Localized term

Pembalikan Saran Resolusi TCAS

Localized example

Jika Pembalikan Saran Resolusi TCAS dikeluarkan, segera balikkan manuver vertikal Anda sesuai instruksi TCAS.
